collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A pig rolls happily in a cool patch of mud near the stream.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A pig rolls happily in a cool patch of mud near the stream. It grunts with such contentment that a passing villager laughs.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A pig rolls happily in a cool patch of mud near the stream. Two children watch and seem to be thinking about joining in.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A pig rolls happily in a cool patch of mud near the stream. The pig comes out caked in mud and shakes it all over (name1).

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A pig rolls happily in a cool patch of mud near the stream. By evening, it is asleep in the mud, snoring loudly.
